title: Legacy postsUpdaterJob cron from the Devvit Blocks version may still fire unseen
current: The app never lists or cancels scheduled jobs. Installations that ran the pre-Devvit Web version may still have a runtime cron named postsUpdaterJob firing every minute with no matching task, so nothing appears in the app's logs.
location: devvit.json (scheduler.tasks has no postsUpdaterJob task); created by _original/src/triggers/appChanged.ts:19 at commit 4783d61^ via startSingletonJob(context.scheduler, 'postsUpdaterJob', '* * * * *', {}); no listJobs or cancelJob anywhere in src/
evidence: The Devvit 0.15 scheduler docs say a job created with scheduler.runJob({ name, cron }) keeps its stored schedule until the app cancels it. The Devvit Web migration (4783d61, 2026-01-26) replaced the job with the devvit.json task posts-updater-job but never cancelled the old runtime job. Characteristics: B, C, E.
outcome: Not observed. Needs a scheduler.listJobs() inventory on a real installation; the Devvit CLI has no command for it.
assumptions: That the old job still exists on some installations (only an inventory can confirm).
That it would show as MANAGER_UNSPECIFIED.
investigate: Log scheduler.listJobs() with no filter on upgrade, then read devvit logs for r/SubGoal and an installation from before 2026-01-26.
What does Devvit do when a job fires with no matching task?
Does it count toward the 10 recurring actions per installation?
Confirm the retired devvit.json crons invite-new-subs-poll-job and invite-new-subs-report-job (2026-10-22 to 2026-11-06) are gone.

criticality.why: Wasted runs and possibly a slot of the 10-recurring-action limit, completely invisible in the app's logs.
